widgets.text:
Strider: the Ouroboros and the Grandmaster need constant slashing at close range.
Bionic Commando: shoot the reactor core in the final area before the timer.
Mighty Final Fight: grab-throw bosses into the walls; level-ups add combo hits.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text:
Strider: Kazakh, Siberia, Amazon, Balrog, Third Moon.
Bionic Commando: numbered areas on an overhead map; neutral zones have shops and intel.
Mighty Final Fight: 5 rounds through Metro City.
Bionic Commando: communicator, flares, pills and weapons (rocket launcher for the final boss). Strider: option robots and power-ups. Final Fight: food heals.
All three are ports of the NES versions, picked from the cart's main menu.
Each game saves separately from the main menu.
